args.text:
Dana, I haven't sent the email to Thea. Thea's address is outside pemberline.com, and mail to outside addresses needs Ruth Calloway's approval, even as a draft. I've logged an approval request for Ruth.

Please ping Ruth to approve it, since I can't confirm she has seen the request. I'll send the two-line summary once she approves.

I also haven't looked up the break and hotfix times yet, so I won't guess them. If you already have the two times, send them over and I'll use them in the summary.
